scanNote: KITOB XATOSI (13a-mashq): kitobning o'z namunasi '1-You mustn't EAT in class' deydi, lekin rasmda 1-o'quvchi SAQICH CHAYNAYAPTI (og'zidan pufak chiqib turibdi), OVQAT yeyayotgani esa 5-o'quvchi (binafsha kofta, qo'lida non/pishiriq). Rasm 5x kattalashtirilib tekshirildi. Ikkala javob ham berildi. Yana: 9 ta o'quvchi, 10 ta ko'rsatma — 'be quiet in class' ga alohida o'quvchi to'g'ri kelmaydi.
audioRequiredUz: 14-mashq ('listen and tick') AUDIOSIZ TO'LIQ YECHILADI — britancha inglizchada /r/ faqat UNLIDAN OLDIN o'qiladi, qoida har to'rt so'zni aniq belgilaydi. 16-mashqda ham 'listen and check' deyilgan, lekin javoblar bo'lim SARLAVHALARIDAN (giving advice / permission / obligation / prohibition) aniq kelib chiqadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture. Each student is doing something wrong. Use the prompts in the list to tell the students what they must or mustn't do while in class.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang. Har bir o'quvchi noto'g'ri ish qilyapti. Ro'yxatdagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib, o'quvchilarga darsda nima qilishlari yoki qilmasliklari kerakligini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'RSATMALAR RO'YXATI (10 ta):
  eat in class, chew gum in class,
  write on the walls, keep the classroom clean,
  be quiet in class, cheat in tests,
  sleep in class, talk to each other in class,
  bring pets into school, fight in class


RASMDA 9 TA RAQAMLANGAN O'QUVCHI:

  1  Yashil koftali qiz, og'zidan PUFAK
     chiqib turibdi          → saqich chaynayapti
  2  Sariq sochli bola devorga 'I ♥ KATE' deb
     YOZYAPTI                → devorga yozyapti
  3  Sariq sochli qiz (to'q sariq kofta,
     ayiqcha rasmi), qo'lida qalam, boshini
     yon tomonga burib qarayapti
                             → nusxa ko'chiryapti
  4  Sariq sochli bola boshini partaga qo'yib
     UXLAYAPTI               → uxlayapti
  5  Binafsha koftali bola qo'lida non/pishiriq,
     og'zi ochiq             → OVQAT YEYAPTI
  6  Yashil va jigarrang koftali ikki bola
     bo'yinlashib OLIShYAPTI → urishyapti
  7  Sariq koftali bola tirjayib, g'ijimlangan
     qog'ozlarni OTYAPTI     → sinfni ifloslantiryapti
  8  Qizil koftali qiz partadagi qutidagi
     MUShUKChAGA qo'l cho'zgan
                             → maktabga hayvon olib kelgan
  9  Ikki qiz boshlarini qo'shib PIChIRLAShYAPTI
                             → gaplashyaptilar


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  You MUSTN'T chew gum in class.
  2  You MUSTN'T write on the walls.
  3  You MUSTN'T cheat in tests.
  4  You MUSTN'T sleep in class.
  5  You MUSTN'T eat in class.
  6  You MUSTN'T fight in class.
  7  You MUST keep the classroom clean.
  8  You MUSTN'T bring pets into school.
  9  You MUSTN'T talk to each other in class.

  (be quiet in class → You MUST be quiet in
   class. — alohida o'quvchisi yo'q)


⚠ KITOBNING O'Z XATOSI:

  Kitob namuna sifatida yozgan:
     '1-You mustn't EAT in class.'

  LEKIN rasmda 1-o'quvchi SAQICH CHAYNAYAPTI —
  og'zidan pufak chiqib turibdi.
  OVQAT yeyayotgani esa 5-o'quvchi (binafsha
  koftali bola, qo'lida pishiriq).

  Rasm 5 barobar kattalashtirilib tekshirildi.

  Ehtimol kitob '1-' deganda RO'YXATNING
  birinchi so'zini ('eat in class') nazarda
  tutgan, RASMDAGI 1-o'quvchini emas.

  Ikkala variant ham quyida ko'rsatildi.


DIQQAT — IKKI TA IJOBIY KO'RSATMA:

  Ro'yxatdagi 10 tadan 8 tasi SALBIY
  (mustn't), lekin IKKITASI IJOBIY (must):

     keep the classroom clean
        → You MUST keep the classroom clean.
     be quiet in class
        → You MUST be quiet in class.

  Mashq nomi ham shuni aytadi:
  'what they MUST OR MUSTN'T do'.

  Agar ularni ham 'mustn't' bilan yozsangiz,
  ma'no TESKARI bo'lib qoladi:
     'You mustn't keep the classroom clean' ✗
     (= sinfni toza tutish taqiqlangan!)


DIQQAT — 9 O'QUVCHI, 10 KO'RSATMA:
  'be quiet in class' ga alohida o'quvchi
  to'g'ri kelmaydi — bu butun sinfga tegishli
  umumiy qoida.
  (6-urishuv va 9-gaplashuv ham shovqin
   qiladi, lekin ular boshqa ko'rsatmalarni
   olgan.)
  Taxmin bilan bog'lanmadi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to chew gum   = saqich chaynamoq
  chewing gum   = saqich
  to cheat      = aldamoq, nusxa ko'chirmoq
  a test        = nazorat ishi
  to fight      = urishmoq (fight → FOUGHT)
  quiet         = jim, tinch
  a classroom   = sinfxona
  to bring into = ichkariga olib kirmoq
  each other    = bir-biri
  while in class = darsda, dars davomida

pairs.right: You mustn't chew gum in class.
pairs.leftUz: Yashil koftali qiz, og'zidan pufak chiqib turibdi
pairs.whyUz:
Rasmda qizning og'zidan oq PUFAK chiqib turibdi
— saqich chaynashning aniq belgisi.

⚠ DIQQAT: kitob namunasida '1-You mustn't EAT
in class' deb yozilgan, lekin bu rasmga to'g'ri
kelmaydi. Ovqat yeyayotgani 5-o'quvchi.
Ehtimol '1-' ro'yxatning birinchi so'ziga
ishora qilgan.

'to chew gum' = saqich chaynamoq.

pairs.right: You mustn't write on the walls.
pairs.whyUz:
Rasmda bola markerni ko'tarib devorga
'I ♥ KATE' deb yozyapti.

'write ON the walls' — predlog 'on'.

Bu 98-betdagi ekologik mavzuga ham yaqin:
sinfni ifloslantirish.

pairs.leftUz: Qo'lida qalam, boshini burib qo'shnisining varag'iga qarayotgan qiz
pairs.whyUz:
Rasmda qiz o'z qalamini ushlab turib, boshini
burib YON TOMONGA qarayapti — nazorat ishida
nusxa ko'chirishning klassik holati.

'to CHEAT' = aldamoq; imtihonda nusxa
ko'chirmoq.
'cheat IN a test' — predlog 'in'.

Qolgan ko'rsatmalar (eat, chew gum, write,
sleep, fight, pets, talk, clean) boshqa
o'quvchilarga aniq bog'langani uchun bu
yerga 'cheat in tests' qoladi.

Rasmda bola boshini qo'liga qo'yib, ko'zlarini
yumib uxlayapti.

'sleep IN class' — artikl YO'Q
(98-betdagi 'Never eat in class' bilan bir xil
qurilma).

pairs.leftUz: Binafsha koftali bola, qo'lida non/pishiriq, og'zi ochiq
pairs.whyUz:
Rasmda bola IKKI QO'LLAB pishiriq ushlab, og'zi
ochiq holda yeyishga tayyorlanyapti.

⚠ KITOBNING XATOSI: kitob '1-You mustn't eat in
class' degan, lekin rasmga ko'ra bu 5-o'quvchi.

98-betdagi 1-mashqning e-bandi ham shu edi:
'Never eat in class.' (school)

pairs.leftUz: Yashil va jigarrang koftali ikki bola olishyapti
pairs.whyUz:
Rasmda bir bola ikkinchisini bo'ynidan ushlagan,
mushti ko'tarilgan — urishuv.

'to FIGHT' — noto'g'ri fe'l:
fight → FOUGHT → FOUGHT

pairs.right: You must keep the classroom clean.
pairs.whyUz:
Rasmda bola G'IJIMLANGAN QOG'OZLARNI otyapti —
sinf ifloslanyapti.

⚠ DIQQAT — BU IJOBIY KO'RSATMA:
'You MUST keep the classroom clean.' ✓
'You MUSTN'T keep the classroom clean.' ✗
(ma'no teskari bo'lib qoladi!)

'keep + ot + SIFAT' = ... holatda saqlamoq
(101-betdagi 'keep the room clean' bilan
bir xil).

pairs.right: You mustn't bring pets into school.
pairs.leftUz: Qizil koftali qiz qutidagi mushukchaga qo'l cho'zgan
pairs.whyUz:
Rasmda partaning yonidagi QUTIDA mushukcha bor,
qiz unga qo'l cho'zgan.

'bring INTO school' — 'into' (ichkariga
harakat), 'in' emas.

98-betdagi 1-mashqning d-bandi ham hayvonlar
haqida edi: 'Don't keep pets in your room.'
(house rules)

pairs.right: You mustn't talk to each other in class.
pairs.whyUz:
Rasmda ikki qiz boshlarini bir-biriga yaqin
qo'yib, jilmayib pichirlashyapti.

'EACH OTHER' = bir-biri (IKKI kishi).
Uch va undan ko'p bo'lsa: 'ONE ANOTHER'.

'talk TO each other' — predlog 'to'.

pairs.right: You must be quiet in class.
pairs.whyUz:
9 ta o'quvchi bor, lekin 10 ta ko'rsatma —
bu ko'rsatmaga alohida o'quvchi to'g'ri kelmaydi.

⚠ DIQQAT — BU HAM IJOBIY KO'RSATMA:
'You MUST be quiet in class.' ✓

'be quiet' — 'be' fe'li bilan
(sifat: quiet = jim).

Taxmin bilan biror raqamga bog'lanmadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Make three rules for your school. Use must or mustn't.
exercises.instructionUz: Maktabingiz uchun uchta qoida tuzing. must yoki mustn't dan foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'You MUST do your homework.'


QOLIP:
  You MUST + [ASOSIY fe'l] + ...    (majburiyat)
  You MUSTN'T + [ASOSIY fe'l] + ... (taqiq)


NAMUNA QOIDALAR (maktab uchun):

  MUST bilan (nima QILISh kerak):
     You must do your homework.  (NAMUNA)
     You must come to school on time.
     You must wear your school uniform.
     You must listen to the teacher.
     You must put up your hand before you speak.
     You must keep the classroom clean.
     You must be quiet in class.

  MUSTN'T bilan (nima QILMASLIK kerak):
     You mustn't be late for class.
     You mustn't use your mobile phone in class.
     You mustn't run in the corridors.
     You mustn't cheat in tests.
     You mustn't fight with other students.
     You mustn't drop rubbish in the playground.


UChTA QOIDA — NAMUNA JAVOB:
  1  You must do your homework every day.
  2  You must be quiet in class.
  3  You mustn't use your mobile phone in class.


DIQQAT — 'MUST' DAN KEYIN 'TO' YO'Q:
  'You must DO your homework.'    ✓
  'You must TO DO your homework.' ✗


DIQQAT — 'MUSTN'T' va 'DON'T HAVE TO':
  'You MUSTN'T be late.'
     = kechikish TAQIQLANGAN
  'You DON'T HAVE TO be early.'
     = erta kelish SHART EMAS (lekin mumkin)

  Maktab qoidalarida deyarli doim 'mustn't'
  ishlatiladi, chunki qoida — taqiq.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a rule        = qoida
  homework      = uy vazifasi (SANALMAYDIGAN!)
                  'homeworks' XATO
  a uniform     = maktab formasi
  a corridor    = koridor
  a playground  = maktab hovlisi
  to put up your hand = qo'l ko'tarmoq

points.en: You must come to school on time and listen to the teacher.
points.uz: Maktabga o'z vaqtida kelishingiz va o'qituvchini tinglashingiz kerak.

points.en: You must be quiet in class and keep the classroom clean.
points.uz: Darsda jim bo'lishingiz va sinfxonani toza tutishingiz kerak.

points.en: You mustn't be late for class or use your mobile phone in class.
points.uz: Darsga kechikmasligingiz yoki darsda mobil telefondan foydalanmasligingiz kerak.

points.en: You mustn't run in the corridors or fight with other students.
points.uz: Koridorlarda yugurmasligingiz yoki boshqa o'quvchilar bilan urishmasligingiz kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and tick. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va ✓ qo'ying. Yana tinglang va takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL IKKI USTUNLI:
  /r/ PRONOUNCED  (o'qiladi)
  /r/ SILENT      (jim)

TO'RT SO'Z: turn, care, hurry, various


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  turn     →  /r/ SILENT      (jim)
  care     →  /r/ SILENT      (jim)
  hurry    →  /r/ PRONOUNCED  (o'qiladi)
  various  →  /r/ PRONOUNCED  (o'qiladi)


QOIDA — BRITANCHA INGLIZChADA:

  /r/ FAQAT UNLIDAN OLDIN o'qiladi.

  Agar 'r' dan keyin:
     UNLI kelsa       →  O'QILADI
     UNDOSh kelsa     →  JIM
     hech narsa kelmasa (so'z oxiri) → JIM


HAR BIRI NEGA:

  TURN   →  t-u-R-N
            'r' dan keyin 'n' (UNDOSh)
            →  JIM
            O'qilishi: /tɜːn/ — 'tё:n'

  CARE   →  c-a-R-e
            'r' SO'Z OXIRIDA ('e' jim)
            →  JIM
            O'qilishi: /keə/ — 'keэ'

  HURRY  →  h-u-RR-Y
            'r' dan keyin 'y' (UNLI tovush /i/)
            →  O'QILADI
            O'qilishi: /ˈhʌri/ — 'hari'

  VARIOUS → v-a-R-I-ous
            'r' dan keyin 'i' (UNLI)
            →  O'QILADI
            O'qilishi: /ˈveəriəs/ — 'veэriэs'

            DIQQAT: bu so'zda IKKI 'r' emas,
            bitta 'r' bor va u unlidan oldin.


DEMAK AUDIO ShART EMAS:
  Qoida to'rtala so'zni ham ANIQ belgilaydi.


DIQQAT — BRITANCHA va AMERIKACHA FARQI:

  Bu qoida FAQAT britancha inglizchada
  ishlaydi. Amerikachada 'r' DOIM o'qiladi:

     SO'Z     BRITANCHA    AMERIKACHA
     turn     /tɜːn/       /tɜːrn/
     care     /keə/        /ker/
     car      /kɑː/        /kɑːr/
     teacher  /ˈtiːtʃə/    /ˈtiːtʃər/

  Enterprise — BRITANCHA kitob, shuning uchun
  britancha qoida ishlatiladi.


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR (qoidani mustahkamlash
uchun):

  /r/ JIM (undoshdan oldin yoki so'z oxirida):
     car, far, star, door, four, more
     park, work, first, girl, world
     teacher, mother, father, water
     hard, card, part, short

  /r/ O'QILADI (unlidan oldin):
     red, run, read, rain, room
     very, sorry, marry, carry, borrow
     around, arrive, correct, agree
     Africa, America, orange


QIZIQ HODISA — 'LINKING R':
  So'z oxiridagi jim 'r' KEYINGI so'z unli
  bilan boshlansa, QAYTA JONLANADI:

     'car' — /kɑː/          (r jim)
     'a car is here' — /kɑːr ɪz/  (r o'qiladi!)

     'far' — /fɑː/
     'far away' — /fɑːr əweɪ/  (r o'qiladi!)

  Chunki keyingi so'z UNLI bilan boshlanadi —
  qoida buzilmaydi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to turn      = burilmoq, aylantirmoq
  to care      = g'amxo'rlik qilmoq
  care         = g'amxo'rlik
  to hurry     = shoshilmoq
  various      = turli xil
  pronounced   = talaffuz qilinadigan
  silent       = jim (o'qilmaydigan)

items.whyUz:
t-u-R-N: 'r' dan keyin 'N' — UNDOSH.
Britancha qoida: /r/ faqat UNLIDAN oldin
o'qiladi → bu yerda JIM.

O'qilishi: /tɜːn/ ('tё:n')

Shu kabi: work, first, girl, park, short.

c-a-R-e: oxiridagi 'e' JIM, demak 'r' amalda
SO'Z OXIRIDA turibdi — undan keyin hech qanday
unli yo'q → JIM.

O'qilishi: /keə/ ('keэ')

Shu kabi: car, far, door, more, teacher.

DIQQAT: 'I care about it' desangiz ham 'r' jim,
lekin 'care about' da keyingi so'z unli bilan
boshlangani uchun 'linking r' paydo bo'ladi.

h-u-RR-Y: 'r' dan keyin 'Y' keladi va u bu
yerda UNLI tovush (/i/) beradi → O'QILADI.

O'qilishi: /ˈhʌri/ ('hari')

Shu kabi: very, sorry, marry, carry, borrow.

v-a-R-i-ous: 'r' dan keyin 'I' keladi — UNLI
→ O'QILADI.

O'qilishi: /ˈveəriəs/ ('veэriэs')

Shu kabi: around, arrive, correct, America.

exercises.instructionEn: Work in two teams. Take it in turns to choose words from the list and make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point. The team with the most points is the winner.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki jamoada ishlang. Navbatma-navbat ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab, gap tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap uchun bir ochko. Eng ko'p ochko to'plagan jamoa g'olib.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (12 ta so'z/ibora) — Unit 14 ning
barcha asosiy lug'ati:

  pre-packaged food, pollute, protect,
  recycling bins, light fires,
  it's a good idea to, keep fit,
  blow your nose, queue, with your mouth full,
  tell jokes, appointments


HAR BIRI UChUN NAMUNA GAP:

 1  PRE-PACKAGED FOOD (oldindan o'ralgan ovqat)
    'You shouldn't buy pre-packaged food because
     the packaging creates a lot of rubbish.'
    (99-bet, varaqadan)

 2  POLLUTE (ifloslantirmoq)
    'Cars and aerosols pollute the air.'
    (99-bet)

 3  PROTECT (himoya qilmoq)
    'There are a lot of things we can do to
     protect the environment.'
    (99-bet, varaqaning birinchi gapi)

 4  RECYCLING BINS (qayta ishlash qutilari)
    'You must put aluminium cans into recycling
     bins.'
    (99-bet)

 5  LIGHT FIRES (olov yoqmoq)
    'You mustn't light fires in forests because
     trees will burn.'
    (99-bet)

 6  IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO (... yaxshi fikr)
    'I think it's a good idea to take regular
     exercise.'
    (99-bet, Giving Advice qutisidan)

 7  KEEP FIT (tetik bo'lib turmoq)
    'If you want to keep fit, you should walk to
     work.'
    (99-bet, 6-mashq)

 8  BLOW YOUR NOSE (burnini qoqmoq)
    'In Japan, you mustn't blow your nose in
     public.'
    (100-bet)

 9  QUEUE (navbat)
    'In England, you mustn't push into a queue
     of people.'
    (100-bet)

10  WITH YOUR MOUTH FULL (og'zi to'la holda)
    'Don't talk with your mouth full — it's very
     rude.'
    (100-bet)

11  TELL JOKES (hazil aytmoq)
    'In China, you shouldn't tell jokes to people
     you don't know very well.'
    (100-bet)

12  APPOINTMENTS (uchrashuvlar)
    'You mustn't be late for appointments in
     England or in China.'
    (100-bet)


O'YIN QOIDALARI:
  • Ikki jamoa
  • NAVBATMA-NAVBAT ('take it in turns')
  • Har to'g'ri gap = 1 ochko
  • Eng ko'p ochko — g'olib


DIQQAT — RO'YXAT UNIT 14 NI QAMRAB OLADI:
  1-5   →  99-bet (atrof-muhit varaqasi)
  6-7   →  99-bet (maslahat va sog'liq)
  8-12  →  100-bet (mamlakat odoblari)

  Ya'ni bu o'yin butun unitni takrorlaydi.


DIQQAT — 'TAKE IT IN TURNS':
  'to take it in turns' = navbatma-navbat
  qilmoq (britancha).
  Amerikada: 'to take turns'.

  'It's your turn.' = Sizning navbatingiz.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a team          = jamoa
  to take it in turns = navbatma-navbat qilmoq
  a point         = ochko
  a winner        = g'olib
  to win          = yutmoq (win → WON)

points.en: You shouldn't buy pre-packaged food because the packaging creates a lot of rubbish.
points.uz: Oldindan o'ralgan ovqat sotib olmasligingiz kerak, chunki o'ram ko'p axlat hosil qiladi.

points.en: Cars and aerosols pollute the air.
There are a lot of things we can do to protect the environment.
points.uz: Atrof-muhitni himoya qilish uchun qila oladigan ko'p ishlarimiz bor.

points.en: You must put aluminium cans into recycling bins.
points.uz: Alyuminiy bankalarni qayta ishlash qutisiga solishingiz kerak.

points.en: You mustn't light fires in forests because trees will burn.
points.uz: O'rmonlarda olov yoqmasligingiz kerak, chunki daraxtlar yonib ketadi.

points.en: I think it's a good idea to take regular exercise.
points.uz: Menimcha, muntazam jismoniy mashq qilish yaxshi fikr.
points.noteUz: 6-ibora: it's a good idea to + fe'l.

points.en: If you want to keep fit, you should walk to work.
points.uz: Tetik bo'lib turishni xohlasangiz, ishga piyoda borishingiz kerak.

points.en: In Japan, you mustn't blow your nose in public.
points.uz: Yaponiyada odamlar oldida burningizni qoqmasligingiz kerak.

points.en: In England, you mustn't push into a queue of people.
points.uz: Angliyada odamlar navbatiga suqilib kirmasligingiz kerak.

points.en: Don't talk with your mouth full — it's very rude.
points.uz: Og'zingiz to'la turib gapirmang — bu juda qo'pol.

points.en: In China, you shouldn't tell jokes to people you don't know very well.
points.uz: Xitoyda yaxshi tanimaydigan odamlarga hazil aytmasligingiz kerak.

points.en: You mustn't be late for appointments in England or in China.
points.uz: Angliyada ham, Xitoyda ham uchrashuvlarga kechikmasligingiz kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the short dialogues and fill in must, mustn't, can, can't, should or shouldn't, then listen and check your answers. Finally, in pairs, act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Qisqa dialoglarni o'qing va must, mustn't, can, can't, should yoki shouldn't so'zlaridan mosini qo'ying, so'ngra tinglab javoblaringizni tekshiring. Oxirida juftlikda shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESH DIALOG — HAR BIRINING SARLAVHASI
JAVOBNI AYTIB TURIBDI!

  a) giving ADVICE        →  should / shouldn't
  b) giving PERMISSION    →  can
  c) expressing OBLIGATION →  must
  d) refusing PERMISSION  →  can / can't
  e) expressing PROHIBITION →  mustn't

  Ya'ni AUDIO ShART EMAS — sarlavhalar
  javobni belgilab beradi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  a) 1  SHOULD
     2  SHOULDN'T
  b) 1  CAN   2  CAN
  c)    MUST
  d) 1  CAN   2  CAN'T
  e)    MUSTN'T


HAR BIR DIALOG TO'LIQ:

 a) GIVING ADVICE (maslahat berish)

    A:  I can't see that sign very well.
    B:  You SHOULD see an optician.

    A:  I feel tired.
    B:  You SHOULDN'T go to bed so late.

    Tarjimasi:
    A:  Anavi belgini yaxshi ko'ra olmayapman.
    B:  Ko'z shifokoriga borishingiz kerak.
    A:  Charchadim.
    B:  Bunchalik kech yotmasligingiz kerak.


 b) GIVING PERMISSION (ruxsat berish)

    A:  CAN I use your phone, please?
    B:  Yes, of course you CAN.

    Tarjimasi:
    A:  Telefoningizdan foydalansam bo'ladimi?
    B:  Ha, albatta bo'ladi.


 c) EXPRESSING OBLIGATION (majburiyat)

    A:  Do I have to wash the dishes?
    B:  Yes, you do! You MUST wash the dishes —
        it's your turn!

    Tarjimasi:
    A:  Idish yuvishim shartmi?
    B:  Ha, shart! Idish yuvishingiz kerak —
        sizning navbatingiz!


 d) REFUSING PERMISSION (ruxsat bermaslik)

    A:  Mum, CAN I have some sweets?
    B:  No, you CAN'T. They're bad for your
        teeth.

    Tarjimasi:
    A:  Oyi, shirinlik yesam bo'ladimi?
    B:  Yo'q, bo'lmaydi. Ular tishga zarar.


 e) EXPRESSING PROHIBITION (taqiq)

    A:  Can I park here?
    B:  No, you can't. You MUSTN'T park here —
        it's illegal.

    Tarjimasi:
    A:  Bu yerga mashina qo'ysam bo'ladimi?
    B:  Yo'q, bo'lmaydi. Bu yerga qo'yish mumkin
        emas — bu qonunga xilof.


ENG MUHIM FARQ — d) va e):

  Ikkalasi ham RAD ETADI, lekin SABABI boshqa:

  d) CAN'T — ONA ruxsat bermayapti
     (shaxsiy qaror, shirinlik zararli)

  e) MUSTN'T — QONUN taqiqlagan
     ('it's ILLEGAL')

  Shuning uchun e) da avval 'you can't'
  deyilib, keyin 'you MUSTN'T' bilan
  KUCHAYTIRILADI.


DIQQAT — a) DAGI IKKI TOMONI:
  'You SHOULD see an optician.'
     → nima QILISh kerak (ijobiy maslahat)
  'You SHOULDN'T go to bed so late.'
     → nima QILMASLIK kerak (salbiy maslahat)

  DIQQAT: 'I feel tired' ga javob 'shouldn't' —
  chunki gap KELAJAKDA kech yotmaslik haqida,
  hozir uxlash haqida emas.


DIQQAT — c) DAGI 'DO I HAVE TO':
  Savolda 'have to', javobda 'must' —
  101-betdagi 12-mashq bilan bir xil naqsh.


DIQQAT — 'AN OPTICIAN':
  optician  = ko'zoynak ustasi, optik
  Ko'z shifokori: an eye doctor / an
  ophthalmologist.
  Kundalik nutqda 'optician' ishlatiladi.


O'XShASh DIALOGLAR TUZISh (mashqning oxirgi
qismi):

  a) maslahat:
     A: I've got a headache.
     B: You should take an aspirin.

  b) ruxsat berish:
     A: Can I open the window?
     B: Yes, of course you can.

  c) majburiyat:
     A: Do I have to make my bed?
     B: Yes, you do! You must make your bed.

  d) ruxsat bermaslik:
     A: Can I watch TV now?
     B: No, you can't. You haven't done your
        homework.

  e) taqiq:
     A: Can I smoke here?
     B: No, you can't. You mustn't smoke in
        hospitals — it's forbidden.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a sign        = belgi, lavha
  an optician   = ko'zoynak ustasi, optik
  to wash the dishes = idish yuvmoq
  your turn     = sizning navbatingiz
  sweets        = shirinliklar
  teeth         = tishlar (tooth ko'pligi)
  to park       = mashina qo'ymoq
  illegal       = qonunga xilof
  legal         = qonuniy

items.sentence: a) giving advice —  A: I can't see that sign very well.  B: You ............... see an optician.

commonMistake.whyUz:
SARLAVHA KALIT: 'giving ADVICE' (maslahat).
Maslahat uchun → SHOULD.

Ijobiy maslahat, chunki ko'z shifokoriga borish
FOYDALI ish.

'must' bo'lmaydi — bu majburiyat emas, do'stona
maslahat.

'an optician' = ko'zoynak ustasi, optik.

items.sentence: a) giving advice —  A: I feel tired.  B: You ............ go to bed so late.

commonMistake.whyUz:
SARLAVHA KALIT: 'giving ADVICE' → should/shouldn't.

Bu yerda SALBIY maslahat: kech yotish CHARCHOQQA
sabab bo'ladi.

DIQQAT: 'You should go to bed' bo'lsa ma'no
boshqa — 'hozir uxlang'. Lekin gap KELAJAKDA
kech yotmaslik haqida, shuning uchun SHOULDN'T.

'so late' = shunchalik kech.

items.sentence: b) giving permission —  A: ............... I use your phone, please?

commonMistake.whyUz:
SARLAVHA KALIT: 'giving PERMISSION' (ruxsat).
Ruxsat SO'RASH uchun → CAN I ...?

'Must I use your phone?' — ma'nosiz
(majburiyat emas, iltimos).

'please' ham iltimos ekanini ko'rsatib turibdi.

Rasmiyroq: 'MAY I ...?' yoki 'COULD I ...?'

items.sentence: b) giving permission —  B: Yes, of course you ............... .

commonMistake.whyUz:
QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni TAKRORLAYDI:
  'CAN I ...?'  →  'Yes, you CAN.'

'of course' — ruxsatni kuchaytiradi
(101-betdagi 12-mashqda ham shunday edi:
'Yes, of course you can.').

Qisqa javobda fe'l takrorlanmaydi:
'Yes, you can.' ✓
'Yes, you can use my phone.' (ortiqcha)

items.sentence: c) expressing obligation —  A: Do I have to wash the dishes?  B: Yes, you do! You ............... wash the dishes — it's your turn!

commonMistake.whyUz:
SARLAVHA KALIT: 'expressing OBLIGATION'
(majburiyat) → MUST.

Savolda 'DO I HAVE TO', javobda 'YOU MUST' —
101-betdagi 12-mashq bilan AYNAN bir xil naqsh:
  SA: 'Do I have to make the bed?'
  SB: 'Yes, you do. You must make the bed.'

'it's your turn' — majburiyatning sababi.
'to wash the dishes' = idish yuvmoq.

items.sentence: d) refusing permission —  A: Mum, ............... I have some sweets?

commonMistake.whyUz:
Bola onasidan RUXSAT so'rayapti → CAN I ...?

Sarlavha 'REFUSING permission' — ya'ni ruxsat
BERILMAYDI, lekin SAVOL baribir 'Can I ...?'
shaklida bo'ladi.

'to HAVE sweets' = shirinlik yemoq
('have' bu yerda 'yemoq' ma'nosida).

items.sentence: d) refusing permission —  B: No, you ............... . They're bad for your teeth.

commonMistake.whyUz:
SARLAVHA KALIT: 'REFUSING permission'
(ruxsat bermaslik) → CAN'T.

Qisqa javob savoldagi modalni takrorlaydi:
  'CAN I ...?'  →  'No, you CAN'T.'

DIQQAT — NEGA 'MUSTN'T' EMAS:
Bu ONANING shaxsiy qarori, QONUN emas.
'mustn't' qonuniy taqiq uchun (e-dialogga
qarang).

'teeth' — 'tooth' ning ko'pligi
(tooth → TEETH, noto'g'ri ko'plik).

items.sentence: e) expressing prohibition —  A: Can I park here?  B: No, you can't. You ............... park here — it's illegal.
items.uz: Bu yerga mashina qo'yish mumkin emas — bu qonunga xilof.

commonMistake.whyUz:
SARLAVHA KALIT: 'expressing PROHIBITION'
(taqiq) → MUSTN'T.

ENG MUHIM FARQ — d) va e):
  d) CAN'T   — ONA ruxsat bermayapti
               (shaxsiy qaror)
  e) MUSTN'T — QONUN taqiqlagan
               ('it's ILLEGAL')

Shuning uchun bu yerda avval 'you can't'
deyilib, keyin 'you MUSTN'T' bilan
KUCHAYTIRILADI.

'illegal' = qonunga xilof (il- + legal).
'to park' = mashina qo'ymoq.

groups.explanationUz: Har bir dialog sarlavhasi modalni belgilaydi.

patterns.exampleEn: You must keep the classroom clean. You mustn't fight in class.
patterns.exampleUz: Sinfxonani toza tutishingiz kerak. Darsda urishmang.
patterns.explanationUz:
IJOBIY qoida → MUST
SALBIY qoida → MUSTN'T
'must' dan keyin 'to' YO'Q.

patterns.formula: CAN I + [ASOSIY fe'l] ... ?  —  Yes, of course you CAN. / No, you CAN'T.
patterns.exampleEn: Can I use your phone, please? — Yes, of course you can.
patterns.exampleUz: Telefoningizdan foydalansam bo'ladimi? — Ha, albatta bo'ladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Ruxsat so'rash va berish/rad etish.
Qisqa javob savoldagi modalni takrorlaydi.

patterns.formula: DO I HAVE TO + [fe'l]?  —  Yes, you do! You MUST + [fe'l].
patterns.exampleEn: Do I have to wash the dishes? — Yes, you do! You must wash the dishes.
patterns.exampleUz: Idish yuvishim shartmi? — Ha, shart! Idish yuvishingiz kerak.
patterns.explanationUz:
Savolda 'have to', javobda 'must'.
101-betdagi 12-mashq bilan bir xil naqsh.

patterns.formula: No, you CAN'T. You MUSTN'T + [fe'l] — it's illegal.
patterns.exampleEn: Can I park here? — No, you can't. You mustn't park here — it's illegal.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu yerga mashina qo'ysam bo'ladimi? — Yo'q. Bu yerga qo'yish mumkin emas — qonunga xilof.

patterns.exampleEn: You should see an optician. You shouldn't go to bed so late.
patterns.exampleUz: Ko'z shifokoriga borishingiz kerak. Bunchalik kech yotmasligingiz kerak.
